description: Boot block entry that issues an exec I/O read of 11264 bytes into a fixed block, builds a copper list of bitplane pointers and a palette copied from a table, and writes custom display and DMA registers. It then ends in an endless loop with no exit.

key: gauntlet ii (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr ecl][t +1 ecl]/Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf:bootblock:0:0060
name: build_copper_bitplane_list
description: Writes copper move pairs that point four bitplane pointers at addresses stepping by 8000 for a row count passed in a register, then copies a 32-entry palette from a table into the copper list. It then issues I/O requests, sets display and DMA registers, and ends in an endless loop.

key: gauntlet ii (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr ecl][t +1 ecl]/Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf:bootblock:0:008C
name: copy_palette_into_copper_list
description: Copies a counted block of words into a copper list as colour-register writes, then issues I/O requests, sets display and DMA registers, and ends in an endless loop. The facts list the CIA-A port, DMA control and potentiometer port registers as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0000
name: disable_then_setup_custom_registers
description: Writes all-ones masks with bit 15 clear to the DMA and interrupt-enable registers, sets display and CIA control values, and calls a series of routines. It finishes with an interrupt-enable mask and an endless loop with no exit.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0034
name: disable_then_setup_custom_registers
description: Same custom-register setup as its neighbour: all-ones masks to the DMA and interrupt registers, display and CIA values, a series of unnamed routine calls, and an endless loop. The facts also list the CIA-A port register as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:00FC
name: write_control_value_seven
description: Writes seven to a global control word and returns. The facts list the interrupt request register as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:010A
name: handle_cia_serial_interrupt
description: Reads CIA-A interrupt-control flags: when bit zero is clear and bit three is set, it writes a rotated, inverted byte to the serial data register and sets a flag, and when bit zero is set it clears that flag. It then writes eight to a global control word.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0140
name: clear_flag_and_load_handler
description: Clears bit six of a byte in a structure, loads a stored value into a handler slot, and writes eight to a global control word. The facts list the interrupt request register as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:015E
name: decrement_counter_and_ack
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter and writes sixteen to a global control word, which the facts link to the interrupt request register. It returns immediately afterwards.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0170
name: service_interrupt_request_bits
description: Reads the interrupt request status and, for each of four request bits, decrements a per-source counter and acknowledges the request by writing its bit back to the interrupt request register when the counter goes negative. It finishes by writing 1920 to a global control word, and the DMA and interrupt-enable registers are listed as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:01FA
name: write_control_word_6144
description: Writes 6144 to a global control word and returns, with no other work. The facts list no hardware register for it.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:01FE
name: write_interrupt_request_6144
description: Writes 6144 to a global word that stands for the interrupt request register, then returns. The facts list that register as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0208
name: write_interrupt_request_8192
description: Writes 8192 to a global word that stands for the interrupt request register, then returns. The facts list that register as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:026C
name: spin_in_endless_loop
description: Loops forever with no exit and does no other work. It is called by six routines.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0384
name: xor_word_pairs_into_memory
description: XORs one pair of words from fixed memory addresses into a destination word, then does the same for a second pair, and returns. It does no other work.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:03A2
name: xor_state_words_with_keys
description: XORs two state words with one key word and two more with a second word, stores one result into a structure, and calls one routine before returning. The routine is a short fixed transform of the state.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:03C8
name: clear_thirty_two_words
description: Zeroes thirty-two consecutive words starting at a fixed block, then returns. Two routines call it.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:03E0
name: clear_thirty_two_words
description: Zeroes thirty-two consecutive words in the same way as its neighbour, and the facts associate the area with the background colour register. One routine calls it.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:03F0
name: transform_thirty_two_source_words
description: Doubles each of thirty-two source words, adds 273, keeps only the low twelve bits and stores each result in a destination block. It is reached only through the gap-decoding rule.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:03F6
name: transform_source_words_by_count
description: Doubles each source word, adds 273, keeps the low twelve bits and stores each result, repeating for a count passed in a register. The facts associate the area with the background colour register.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0410
name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Polls the blitter-busy bit of the DMA control read register and loops while it is set, then returns zero. Four routines call it.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:049C
name: call_eleven_routines_in_order
description: Calls eleven other routines in sequence and then returns, with no other code. Its body is only those calls.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0510
name: call_four_routines_only
description: Calls four other routines in sequence and returns, with no other code. Its body is only those calls.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0534
name: call_four_routines_only
description: Calls four other routines in sequence and returns; its body is only those calls. It is called by one routine.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0550
name: call_three_routines_only
description: Calls three other routines in sequence and returns, with no other code.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0572
name: forward_single_call_entry
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no other code.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:057E
name: decrement_counter_and_ack
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter, calls one routine, and writes sixteen to a global control word, which the facts link to the interrupt request register. It returns afterwards.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0592
name: wait_port_bit_run_loop
description: Waits for a fixed delay and then, while a CIA-A port bit stays clear, waits for it to be set before writing 240 to a global control word. It then calls several routines in a loop that ends when a global word reaches minus 99, and the facts also list the vertical position register as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0602
name: call_three_routines_only
description: Calls three other routines in sequence and returns, with no other code. It is called by three routines.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:061E
name: step_palette_toward_target
description: Copies sixteen words into a palette area, then makes sixteen passes that call three routines and move each colour word one unit toward its target in each four-bit component. The stepped words are written to an output buffer on each pass.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:063E
name: step_palette_toward_target
description: Performs the same palette stepping as its neighbour: sixteen copied words, then sixteen passes that move each colour word one unit toward its target in each four-bit component. The facts associate the area with the background colour register.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:06AC
name: decode_run_length_into_planes
description: Decodes a signed-count run-length stream into a screen area of 200 rows and four planes of 40 bytes each, repeating the following byte for negative counts and copying literal bytes for positive counts. The destination steps between planes and rows as the rows are filled.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:06CC
name: decode_run_length_into_planes
description: Is the same run-length decoder as its neighbour, writing 200 rows across four planes of 40 bytes each, repeating bytes for negative counts and copying bytes for positive counts. It returns once every row has been written.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:06F4
name: decode_run_length_then_jump
description: Decodes a run-length stream into the same plane layout as its siblings, writing literal and repeated bytes and stepping rows and planes. It ends with a call through a jump table that the decompiler could not resolve, so its final target is unknown.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:070A
name: run_200_row_call_loop
description: Sets a pointer and makes two calls, then calls eight routines for each of 200 rows, makes one more call, and ends in an endless loop of five calls per pass. The called routines are not named in the executable.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:076C
name: call_routines_in_fixed_loop
description: Stores one constant, calls a routine, then runs a counted loop of ten passes that each call five routines. It then stores a second constant, makes four more calls, and returns.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:07B0
name: swap_eight_word_pairs
description: Swaps eight pairs of words between two regions, one advancing by four bytes per pass and the other by two, and then returns. It touches no hardware registers.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:07DC
name: start_copper_list_dma
description: Points the copper list location register at a fixed list, strobes the copper jump register to restart it, and writes the DMA control register with bit 15 set to enable master, bitplane and copper DMA. It has no other code.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:07F6
name: wait_then_start_copper_dma
description: Calls one routine repeatedly until a stored word equals 1793, then points the copper list register at a fixed list, strobes the copper jump register and enables master, bitplane and copper DMA. Those writes match the previous routine.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:081E
name: copy_table_words_with_wrap
description: Advances a table index by two, resets it when it goes negative, then copies 98 words from the table into a destination array with a stride of eight bytes. The source wraps back to its start whenever it reaches a negative entry.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0CE6
name: setup_blitter_masks_modulos
description: Enables blitter DMA through the DMA control register, sets the first and last word masks to all ones, and zeroes the blitter modulo and control registers. It also clears a blitter-control word, and the facts list these blitter registers as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0D14
name: queue_four_blit_parameter_sets
description: Sets the DMA control register with bits 15 and 10 set, writes pointer and size values to the blitter registers for each of four calls, and clears bit 10 of the DMA control register at the end. The facts list the blitter registers and DMA control register as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0DEA
name: setup_blitter_masks_modulos
description: Performs the same blitter setup as its neighbour, but writes 28 to the blitter modulo registers instead of zero. The facts list the blitter registers and DMA control register as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0E20
name: queue_four_blit_parameter_sets
description: Sets the DMA control register with bits 15 and 10 set, writes pointer and size values to the blitter registers for each of four calls, and clears bit 10 of the DMA control register at the end. The facts list the blitter registers and DMA control register as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0EDE
name: setup_blitter_masks_modulos
description: Performs the same blitter setup as its neighbours, but writes 34 to the blitter modulo registers instead of zero. The facts list the blitter registers and DMA control register as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0F14
name: run_four_blits_for_row
description: When a row value lies between 39 and 199, it writes pointer and size values to the blitter registers for four calls, and clears bit 10 of the DMA control register afterwards. Outside that range it does nothing.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:0FFC
name: set_two_audio_channel_registers
description: Writes a sample pointer, a length, a volume of 64 and a period of 729 into two channel blocks sixteen bytes apart, one block for each of two channels. The facts list no hardware register for this routine, but the offsets match the audio channel layout.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:1032
name: start_audio_channel_on_index
description: When the index equals 128 it enables audio channel zero, and when it equals 122 it enables channel one, each with a DMA control write and an interrupt-enable write that set bit 15. It also sets a flag byte when channel zero is started.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:1074
name: copy_rows_of_sample_data
description: Copies bytes from a source table into a destination buffer in rows of 512 bytes, moving to the next of eleven segments each time a row fills, until the destination end is reached. It then sets a completion flag, and it calls routines between segments.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:10F0
name: start_disk_read_dma
description: Points the disk DMA pointer at a buffer, writes the disk sync word 17545, sets the ADKCON and disk length registers with DMA enabled, and calls routines before and after the setup. The facts list the disk and ADKCON registers as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:10FA
name: start_disk_read_dma
description: Starts a disk read like its neighbour: for a counter below eight it uses a fixed buffer and an alternate length, otherwise it uses the standard buffer and sync setup. The facts list the disk and ADKCON registers as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:11CC
name: decode_disk_sector_with_checksum
description: Decodes raw sector data from alternate bit pairs, checks the decoded sector number and a checksum over 128 longs, and returns the data pointer on success. It retries a fixed number of times and ends in an endless loop when every attempt fails.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:12AE
name: scan_track_for_sync_matches
description: Scans a raw track buffer for a matching sync value, records up to six positions, shifts each recorded block to align its bits, and copies it into one of six output slots spaced 2080 bytes apart. It uses fixed loop counts and returns once every recorded position has been processed.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:1310
name: copy_aligned_records_to_slots
description: Processes recorded positions from a list, takes a slot number from each one, and copies about 1032 words into the matching output slot spaced 2080 bytes apart. It returns when the list is empty.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:1350
name: stub_return_only
description: The routine only returns a value that was passed on the stack and performs no work. It is reached through the gap-decoding rule rather than a named call.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:1356
name: setup_disk_drive_then_call
description: Writes 16384 to the disk length register, enables a DMA bit with bit 15 set, sets one CIA port register to all ones and another to 3, then makes three calls. The facts list the disk length and DMA control registers as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:13B2
name: wait_for_interrupt_request_bit
description: Waits until bit one of the interrupt request read register is set, then acknowledges it by writing two to the interrupt request register and returns that bit. The facts list the interrupt request and read registers as touched.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:13CA
name: step_disk_head_to_track
description: Halves a requested track value and compares it with the current track, then sets the direction bit on a CIA-B port and steps the head one track at a time with a fixed delay per step until it arrives. It does nothing for requests of 160 or more.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:1456
name: step_disk_head_one_track
description: Increments the current track counter and, while it stays below 160, pulses the head step line with a fixed delay on even steps and clears it on odd steps, then returns the new count. At 160 or more it clears the direction bit and calls another routine instead.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:14C4
name: pulse_disk_line_while_flag
description: Sets a control bit on a CIA-B port, then pulses another bit with a fixed delay for as long as a flag bit in a global word stays set. It finally clears a third bit and resets the global word to zero.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:1510
name: set_port_control_bits
description: Sets bits three and seven of a port control register while leaving its other bits unchanged, then returns. The facts list no registers for this routine, but the write goes to the CIA-B port.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:1540
name: set_port_bits_four_seven
description: Sets bits four and seven of a CIA-B port register while leaving its other bits unchanged, then returns. It makes no calls.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:1570
name: clear_port_bits_then_call
description: Clears bits three and seven of a CIA-B port register, then calls one other routine and returns.

key: Gauntlet II (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr ECL][t +1 ECL].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $06B000 (7680 bytes):0:158E
name: clear_port_bits_then_call
description: Clears bits four and seven of a CIA-B port register, then calls one other routine and returns. It is reached only through the gap-decoding rule.
